```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Load packages

```{r load, out.width = "100%", dpi = 300, echo = TRUE, warning=FALSE}
library(here)
library(StereoMorph)
library(geomorph)
library(wesanderson)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
```

## dataframe
```{r read, out.width = "100%", dpi = 300, echo = TRUE, warning=FALSE}
shapes <- readShapes("shapes")
shapesGM <- readland.shapes(shapes, nCurvePts = c(10, 10, 10, 10))
```

## Read qualitative data
```{r read qual, out.width = "100%", dpi = 300, echo = TRUE, warning=FALSE}
qdata <- read.csv("qdata.csv",
                  header = TRUE,
                  row.names = 1)
```

## GPA
```{r gp, out.width = "100%", dpi = 300, echo = TRUE, warning=FALSE}
Y.gpa <- gpagen(shapesGM, print.progress = FALSE)

# Plot the GPA results with a title
plot(Y.gpa)
title(main = "BLR Analysis - Perdiz Point GPA") 

```

## dataframe
```{r dataframe, out.width = "100%", dpi = 300, echo = TRUE, warning=FALSE}
gdf <- geomorph.data.frame(shape = Y.gpa$coords,
                            size = Y.gpa$Csize,
                            region = qdata$ecoregion) #ecoregions

# add centroid size to qdata
qdata$csz <- Y.gpa$Csize
```

## Boxplot
```{r box, out.width = "100%", dpi = 300, echo = TRUE, warning=FALSE}
#attributes
csz <- qdata$csz
corep <- qdata$ecoregion

# palette (because women belong in sciences!)
pal <- c(
  "#FFB7C5",  # pastel pink
  "#D291BC",  # soft lilac
  "#F7C5E0",  # bubblegum
  "#CBAACB",  # dusty mauve
  "#FFD1DC",  # light pink
  "#E0BBE4",  # soft lavender
  "#DA70D6",  # orchid
  "#FF99C8",  # cotton candy
  "#F4A7B9"   # rose blush
)

#boxplot of Perdiz arrow points by region
csz.reg <- ggplot(qdata, aes(x = ecoregion, y = csz, color = region)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(x = 'Region', y = 'Centroid Size')

# render plot
csz.reg
```

## ANOVA - shape and size
```{r shapesize, out.width = "100%", dpi = 300, echo = TRUE, warning=FALSE}
#size
fit.sz.reg <- procD.lm(size ~ corep,
                       data = gdf,
                       print.progress = FALSE,
                       iter = 9999)

# size
anova(fit.sz.reg)

# pairwise comparison of LS means = which differ? (remember this is size)
sz.reg <- pairwise(fit.sz.reg,
                   groups = qdata$ecoregion)

#pairwise comparison with Bonferroni correction (because comparing so many things)
sz.reg$p.adjusted <- p.adjust(sz.reg$TL$pval, method = "bonferroni")

summary(sz.reg,
        confidence = 0.95,
        test.type = "dist")

# shape
fit.sh.reg <- procD.lm(shape ~ corep,
                       data = gdf,
                       print.progress = FALSE,
                       iter = 9999)

#shape
anova(fit.sh.reg)

# pairwise comparison of LS means = which differ? (now looking at shpae)
sh.reg <- pairwise(fit.sh.reg,
                   groups = qdata$ecoregion)
#pairwise comparison with Bonferroni correction (because comparing so many things)
sz.reg$p.adjusted <- p.adjust(sz.reg$TL$pval, method = "bonferroni")

summary(sh.reg,
        confidence = 0.95,
        test.type = "dist")
```

## Mean shapes
```{r mean-shape-comparisons, out.width = "100%", dpi = 300, echo = TRUE, warning=FALSE}

# Subset landmark coordinates by ecoregion group
new.coords <- coords.subset(A = Y.gpa$coords,
                            group = qdata$ecoregion)
region_names <- names(new.coords)

# Calculate mean shapes for each region
mean_shapes <- lapply(new.coords, mshape)
names(mean_shapes) <- region_names

# Plot mean shapes
for (name in region_names) {
  plot(mean_shapes[[name]], main = paste("Mean Shape:", name))
}

# Create all pairwise combinations
comparison_pairs <- combn(region_names, 2, simplify = FALSE)

# Show pairwise comparisons with pink and purple colors (because women and nonbinary people belong in coding), NO numbers, and a adjusted legend 
for (pair in comparison_pairs) {
  ref <- mean_shapes[[pair[1]]]
  target <- mean_shapes[[pair[2]]]
  
  # Combine coordinates for limit setting
  all_x <- c(ref[,1], target[,1])
  all_y <- c(ref[,2], target[,2])
  
  # Set plot limits with some padding
  xlim_range <- range(all_x) + c(-0.1, 0.1) * diff(range(all_x))
  ylim_range <- range(all_y) + c(-0.1, 0.1) * diff(range(all_y))
  
  # Set up the plot
  plot(ref[,1], ref[,2],
       asp = 1,
       pch = 16,
       col = "pink",
       xlim = xlim_range,
       ylim = ylim_range,
       xlab = "X",
       ylab = "Y",
       main = paste("Ref:", pair[1], "→ Target:", pair[2]))
  
  # Add the target points
  points(target[,1], target[,2], 
         pch = 17, 
         col = "purple")
   # Add a cleaner legend
  legend("bottomleft", 
         legend = c(paste("Ref:"), paste("Target:")), 
         col = c("pink", "purple"), 
         pch = c(16, 17),
         pt.cex = 1.5,    # bigger points in legend
         cex = 0.8,       # shrink text slightly
         bty = "n",       # no box around the legend
         inset = 0.02)    # slight inset to avoid the edges
  
 
}

```
